note: Ten keystone traces. Every trace is concept-local demo state and says so; nothing here masquerades as production wiring.

traces.mutation_or_operation: route.go(result.dest, {focus: rid}); open() resolves the rid back to the richer dest (sectionId) and performs load domain > open manager > select object > select tab > scroll row > focus > calm pm2-located
traces.receipt: none (navigation); availability note toasts when the result is unavailable
traces.ui_projection: exact element carries pm2-located and keyboard focus; crumb pile shows the full pile

traces.validation_permission: Settings write; preview token must match a staged preview
traces.mutation_or_operation: PM2.copy.apply(token): restore point > atomic write of add/replace items > verify > receipt; unavailable and conflict rows are never written
traces.receipt: Copy complete — receiptId + restorePointId + applied count + verified
traces.ui_projection: receipt sheet with working Rollback; ops strip shows staged phases with a real denominator

traces.validation_permission: receipt must exist and not already be rolled back
traces.mutation_or_operation: PM2.copy.rollback(receiptId) restores every written value exactly from the restore point
traces.receipt: Copy rolled back — both directions recorded
traces.ui_projection: receipt sheet flips to rolled-back state; Verified line reads Superseded by rollback

traces.validation_permission: store validation by type/options/bounds; managed and unavailable rows render disabled controls
traces.mutation_or_operation: store.setValue(id, v) with {ok:false,error} surfaced as an inline row error (role=alert); success re-renders the row and prepends the recents feed
traces.ui_projection: chip flips default>custom; Home recent-changes list gains the entry

traces.validation_permission: ask-first policy: the click is the ask; manual-only installations refuse honestly and expose no update action
traces.mutation_or_operation: PM2.states.trigger('install-update', instId) — staged install then the verify checklist; failure path rolls back and records history
traces.receipt: op terminal state (verified or rolled back) in the ops strip + activity log
traces.ui_projection: installation card status word + update history in the detail disclosure

traces.validation_permission: explicit user click on the setup tab; never bundled, pre-seeded, or demand-triggered
traces.mutation_or_operation: runOp('install-acquire','cursor-cli') from the official source for the exact selected host/environment; sign-in stays separate
traces.ui_projection: setup tab: official source line, policy note, host/environment radios, numbered steps, single explicit CTA

traces.mutation_or_operation: route.go({route:'dest', cat}); grouped tabs remember the last lens category so re-selection is stable
traces.ui_projection: active tab underline + crumb pile reset to Home > Category; sheet settles with the lift-and-settle motion

traces.mutation_or_operation: per-subgroup disclosure state (advOpen) reveals the advanced + unchanged overflow; deep links auto-open it when the target row lives behind it
traces.ui_projection: Show N more (advanced & unchanged) toggle; landing never dead-ends behind a closed fold

traces.mutation_or_operation: facet state (category/type/tier/state/changed + text) filters the resolved 828-row index; windowed rendering keeps ~30 live rows
traces.ui_projection: count line 'N of 828'; stress records appear only when active, marked Stress fixture and non-navigable

traces.mutation_or_operation: Escape: close popup > close drawer > one sheet out (route.go(parent)) > stop at Home; never closes Settings
traces.ui_projection: verified rung sequence manager/m.providers/claude/models > manager/m.providers > dest/ai > home > home
